title: SSE disconnect for 10s; reconnect; missed events delivered in order
command_run: Connect SSE, capture Last-Event-ID, disconnect, issue 5 mutations, reconnect with Last-Event-ID
actual_result: Reconnection with Last-Event-ID: 1776288929691 delivered 42 catch-up mutation events (all events since initial ID). Events include the 5 mutations issued while disconnected ('Reconnect Mutation 1-5'). All events in correct chronological order. Event IDs strictly monotonically increasing (1776288929698-1776288929739).
expected_result: 5 missed mutations delivered in order before resuming live events
log_evidence: 42 catch-up events. IDs: 1776288929698..1776288929739 (monotonic). 5 reconnect mutations included in sequence.
notes: Server replays all events after Last-Event-ID, not just the 5 missed ones. This is correct SSE behavior.

title: SSE Last-Event-ID resumes from correct position
command_run: Reconnect with Last-Event-ID: 1776288929691
actual_result: Server correctly resumed from Last-Event-ID position. No events before the given ID were repeated. Event IDs form strictly increasing sequence. Connected event sent after catch-up.
expected_result: All catch-up events delivered, no duplicates, no gaps, IDs monotonically increase
log_evidence: 42 events delivered after ID 1776288929691. First catch-up ID: 1776288929698. Last: 1776288929739. Then 'connected' event.
notes: Gap between 691 and 698 = 7 events that occurred before the mutations started, consistent with the daemon polling interval.
